programmes.amount_note: EUR 50,000 equity-free funding for product and IP development, plus up to two years of incubation with technical support from ESA experts, business coaching, legal and IPR advice and fundraising support. Some national BICs add local top-up funding.
programmes.deadline_note: This ESA BIC runs its own call cycle with published cut-off dates, typically two to four per year. Contact the local centre for the next deadline.

procedure_steps.detail: Contact the local ESA BIC to discuss suitability
Submit application documents before the local deadline
Tender Opening Board review, then presentation to the Tender Evaluation Board
Register a company in Czechia before signing the incubation contract

eligibility.other_note: Business must use space-based systems, apply space technology in a non-space domain, or develop products and services for the space sector. Company must be registered in Czechia.

programmes.deadline_note: Proposal window 10.9.2026 - 27.10.2026 (submission until 16:29:59 in SISTA). Results expected 31.3.2027.

programmes.name_en: National Guarantee – credit guarantee for small businesses (NRB)
programmes.funder: Národní rozvojová banka (NRB), funded by the Ministry of Industry and Trade
programmes.amount_note: Guarantee of up to 70% of a commercial bank loan of CZK 0.5 to 20 million, for up to 10 years, no fees; covers investment and operating expenses (buildings, machinery, technology, licences, stock).
programmes.deadline_note: Applications are accepted continuously (active since 18 December 2025) through cooperating banks.

procedure_steps.detail: Choose a cooperating partner bank and agree the loan
Arrange the National Guarantee online with NRB and the partner

eligibility.other_note: Sole traders (živnostníci), small and medium enterprises; the project location must be a registered establishment or the registered seat of the applicant in Czechia; guarantee covers the loan, not a cash grant.

programmes.source_snippet: Národní záruka je stěžejním záručním programem podpory rozvoje malých a středních podniků

programmes.name_en: Transformation Guarantee – credit guarantee for the Karlovy Vary, Ústí and Moravia-Silesia regions
programmes.amount_note: Guarantee of up to 80% of a loan of CZK 0.5 to 40 million, up to 7 years, no fee; covers operating and investment expenses.
programmes.deadline_note: Applications are accepted continuously since 15 December 2025.

procedure_steps.detail: Agree a loan with a cooperating bank
Apply for the Transformation Guarantee with NRB through the bank

eligibility.other_note: Businesses and sole traders operating in the Karlovarský, Ústecký or Moravskoslezský region; guarantee on a bank loan, not a cash grant.

programmes.source_snippet: Cílem produktu Záruka Transformace je stimulovat ekonomický růst a zajistit přechod na udržitelnější ekonomiku podnikům a firmám působícím v Karlovarském, Ústeckém nebo Moravskoslezském kraji.

programmes.funder: Agentura pro podnikání a inovace (API) / Ministry of Industry and Trade, OP TAK
programmes.amount_note: Allocation CZK 345 million for less developed regions and CZK 195 million for transition regions; support for SMEs in rural areas through Local Action Groups (MAS) with an approved programme framework.

procedure_steps.detail: Check that the project location is in a MAS territory with an approved programme framework
Submit the application for support through the OP TAK system (see the API call page)

eligibility.other_note: Small and medium enterprises; projects must be located in a MAS territory with an approved programme framework, outside municipalities above 25,000 inhabitants and outside Prague.

programmes.source_snippet: Cílem výzvy je podpora malých a středních podniků ve venkovských oblastech prostřednictvím Místních akčních skupin se schváleným programovým rámcem.

programmes.funder: CzechInvest / Czech Government (Act on investment incentives)
programmes.amount_note: Corporate income tax relief up to 10 years, job-creation grant of CZK 300 or 200 thousand per job (in districts with unemployment above 7.5% and 50% above the Czech average), training grant up to 70% (small) or 60% (medium) of training costs; state aid up to 40-60% (small) or 30-50% (medium) of eligible costs. Minimum investment in long-term assets: CZK 20 million (small) or 40 million (medium) in developed regions, CZK 10 million or 20 million in regions with special state support, with high added value.
programmes.deadline_note: Applications are filed with CzechInvest before starting the investment; there is no fixed call window on the page.

procedure_steps.detail: Contact CzechInvest to confirm the project meets the minimum investment and high-added-value conditions
File the investment incentive application with CzechInvest before starting the investment

eligibility.other_note: Small enterprise: fewer than 50 employees and turnover and balance sheet not above EUR 10 million (group level); medium: 50-250 employees, turnover up to EUR 50 million, balance sheet up to EUR 43 million. Large enterprises are also eligible at lower intensities.

programmes.source_snippet: The maximum state aid for a small-sized enterprise is 40-60 %(depends on the region) of eligible costs.

File the investment incentive application before starting the investment
